title: Macarons
description: A traditional France dish made with almond flour, pasteurized egg whites. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Sift almond flour with powdered sugar. Whip pasteurized egg whites with granulated sugar into a stable meringue and fold until it flows in thick ribbons.
Pipe uniform circles onto parchment and tap the tray to remove bubbles.
Rest the piped shells for 30–40 minutes until a dry skin forms and a fingertip no longer sticks.
Bake the shells at 145–155°C for about 15 minutes; let cool fully before removing from the tray.
Cream butter with vanilla and powdered sugar, fill the cooled shells and sandwich pairs together. Refrigerate overnight for the proper texture.
